PreToolUse.command: bash -c 'TOOL=$(echo "$HOOK_TOOL_NAME" | tr -d "\n"); if [ "$TOOL" = "run_in_terminal" ]; then INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); BRANCH=$(git -C /home/vscode/projects/nats-runner rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git (commit|push|merge)"; then if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ] || [ "$BRANCH" = "develop" ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"ask\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"You are on protected branch ($BRANCH). Direct commits/pushes to main or develop are not allowed. Create a feature branch first: git checkout -b feat/<name>\"}}"; exit 0; fi; fi; echo "$INPUT"; fi'
